results.title: A Nepali among eight injured in Dammam airport attack
results.content: The airport attack came hours after falling debris from a drone intercepted by Saudi air defences near a processing facility at Aramco’s Shaybah oil field killed a Nepali and a Filipino worker and injured two others.

results.title: What is PHP, and why are security flaws putting European government websites at risk?
results.content: Two critical flaws could let hackers take control of vulnerable servers, prompting warnings to patch systems or take websites offline.

results.title: Scrub typhus death toll reaches ten in Salyan
results.content: The district has recorded 817 infections, with Darma Rural Municipality reporting the highest number of cases.

results.title: Kathmandu to host Cricket World Cup Qualifier Play-Off in December
results.content: Eight teams will compete for four places in the 2027 ICC Men’s Cricket World Cup Qualifier, with Nepal, the UAE, Namibia and Canada among the participants.

results.title: Two killed in motorcycle crash in Arghakhanchi
results.content: The motorcycle crashed in Bhumikasthan Municipality-2 on Wednesday night, killing the father and son at the scene.

results.title: ICC recognises Nepal Premier League matches as List A T20 fixtures
results.content: The recognition means performances in the October 26-November 21 tournament will count towards official T20 statistics.

results.title: Putin agrees to resume 3-way peace talks with Ukraine and US
results.content: The Kremlin says the next round of US-mediated talks could begin in November, but Moscow and Kyiv remain far apart on territorial concessions, security guarantees and the terms of a peace deal.

results.title: After Nepal’s recent disaster, it wants to test whether COP31 can deliver climate justice
results.content: Nepal has made an emergency appeal to the UN’s loss-and-damage fund, which has yet to disburse any money. Meanwhile, families wait for relief, and the country takes on more loans to rebuild.

results.title: Nepali worker killed in drone attack on Saudi Aramco oil field
results.content: A Filipino national was also killed, while a Pakistani and an Indian worker were injured, Saudi Arabia’s energy ministry says.

results.title: Dashain just isn’t the same in this village anymore
results.content: In Dadeldhura’s Kafali, families have dwindled from 17 to six as people leave in search of better services and livelihoods, leaving behind empty homes and fading festival traditions.

results.title: Nepal to host 15 matches at 2027 Under-19 Women’s T20 World Cup
results.content: The 16-team tournament will run for 17 days, with Kathmandu hosting Nepal’s group-stage matches against Ireland, India and West Indies.

results.title: How cheap Chinese antibiotics threaten Europe's last major penicillin plant
results.content: Cheap Chinese supplies threaten Europe’s last penicillin plant, raising fears of drug shortages and dependence on imports.

results.title: Foreign tourists join Dashain celebrations in Thamel
results.content: Visitors at a Kathmandu hotel receive tika and jamara on Bijaya Dashami, embracing one of Nepal’s biggest festivals and its cultural traditions.

results.title: Five detained for allegedly allowing Nepalis to gamble at Parsa casino
results.content: Nepali law bars citizens from entering casinos and gambling, but police say the facility was allowing them to do so.

results.title: Even on Dashain, some Nepalis leave their families behind in search of a better future abroad
results.content: After celebrating the festival with loved ones, migrant workers head to the airport with tika and jamara on their foreheads, bound for jobs and opportunities overseas.

results.title: Former president Bidya Devi Bhandari to leave for China on Thursday
results.content: Her trip to a global governance forum will be her first overseas visit since her nomination as a senior CPN-UML leader.

results.title: Trump administration says it has revoked over 300,000 visas
results.content: The latest figure marks a sharp rise in visa cancellations as the Trump administration intensifies its immigration crackdown, drawing criticism over due process, free speech and alleged racial profiling.

results.title: President Paudel receives Dashain tika at Sheetal Niwas
results.content: Ramchandra Paudel received tika, jamara and religious offerings from his priest at 10:26am before blessing his wife and other family members.

results.title: Dashain’s sacred jamara draws buyers in Kathmandu
results.content: Crowds gather in the Kasthamandap area to buy bundles of jamara, placed on people’s heads as a blessing during Vijaya Dashami.

results.title: Dashain should inspire fight against corruption, poor governance, says PM Shah
results.content: In his Vijaya Dashami message, Balendra Shah calls for collective action to end bureaucratic delays, inequality and political distortions and restore public trust in government.

results.title: Bird strike disrupts flights at Kathmandu airport
results.content: A pigeon struck a Turkish Airlines aircraft during landing, damaging a nose landing gear light and delaying flight operations while the runway was cleared.

results.title: Dashain takes me back to the child I once was
results.content: From village gatherings and tika from grandparents to the struggles of celebrating away from home, the festival remains a reminder of childhood joys and the family bonds that endure.

results.title: For some in Kathmandu, Dashain is just another day
results.content: Unable to afford the journey home or even new clothes for their children, daily-wage earners struggle to find joy in Nepal’s biggest festival.

results.title: Nepal Premier League to introduce DRS for third edition
results.content: The system will use 3D ball-tracking and AI-based edge detection to help review umpiring decisions, including LBW, run-outs and stumpings.

results.title: UN experts urge India to stop excessive force against youth protesters
results.content: Experts cite alleged arbitrary detentions, police violence and gender-based abuse as they call for independent investigations into the handling of protests over education policies and voter-roll deletions.

results.title: Nepali workers returning from India face overcharging at the border
results.content: Workers returning home for Dashain say inflated fares and repeated checks persist, but few complain about the extra costs.

results.title: The Dashain break is a chance to see more of Nepal and beyond
results.content: From Everest Base Camp and Mustang to Southeast Asia, the long holiday offers plenty of ways to travel. But weather, altitude, visas and rising airfares call for careful planning.

results.title: More than 576,000 leave Kathmandu Valley for Dashain
results.content: Holiday travel is building as families head home for the festival, with traffic police stepping up checks at major exit points.

results.title: Parsa police arrest 103 convicted fugitives in a month
results.content: Police say the arrests will help enforce court rulings against people who had evaded prison terms and fines.

results.title: Declared dead: Indian voters fight to get back on electoral rolls
results.content: A voter roll revision has removed 130 million names across India, leaving many people scrambling to prove they are alive, establish residency and reclaim their right to vote.

results.title: Movie review: ‘12 Gaun 2’ delivers the fights but forgets the story
results.content: Biraj Bhatta’s sequel is weighed down by a disjointed plot, underwritten characters and a villain whose portrayal leans on a damaging stereotype.

results.title: For Timure’s flood survivors, Dashain brings memories of the lives they lost
results.content: Displaced by the Bhotekoshi flood, 111 families are spending the festival in a Kathmandu monastery, grieving loved ones and wondering when they can return home.

results.title: As France erupts, Europe’s far right gains from fuel-price anger ahead of elections
results.content: Surging energy costs and a deepening cost-of-living crisis are fuelling protests across the continent, giving far-right parties fresh momentum as they call for tax cuts and a return to Russian energy supplies ahead of key elections.

results.title: Two killed in wild elephant attack in Jhapa
results.content: A 73-year-old man and a 70-year-old woman were attacked while out on a morning walk in Barhadashi Rural Municipality.

results.title: Far from home, Dashain carries a different kind of ache
results.content: In Japan, a Nepali migrant celebrates with friends beside Hiroshima’s Motoyasu river, finding a sense of belonging while longing for family, home and a father who will never welcome him back.

results.title: In Gorkha’s flood-hit villages, even cooking a meal is a struggle
results.content: The Budhigandaki flood destroyed homes and disrupted road links, leaving families dependent on limited helicopter deliveries for food and other essentials.

results.title: Devotees throng Taleju Bhawani temple on Maha Navami
results.content: Open to the public only once a year, the temple in Kathmandu’s Hanuman Dhoka Durbar complex draws large crowds of worshippers during Dashain.

results.title: Musk pledges SpaceX shares to every child in America amid scrutiny of Big Tech
results.content: The billionaire’s proposal follows Anthropic’s plan to commit at least 5 percent of its shares to social causes, as the technology industry faces growing criticism over AI’s impact on jobs and society.

results.title: Ronaldo handed 30-day ban for leaving Portugal camp following coach Jesus rift
results.content: The Portuguese FA also fined the 41-year-old forward €255 after upholding a charge over his departure from the national team camp following a dispute with coach Jorge Jesus over his role in the side.

results.title: Baglung flood survivors face Dashain without homes as rebuilding stalls
results.content: Families in Baglung are living in a cooperative building, relatives’ homes and a buffalo shed after floods swept away their houses and farmland. Many struggle to secure land and meet government requirements for reconstruction aid.
